items.title: Add historical all-seed backfill orchestration
items.context: Create a digest-bound command that can dry-run and apply all currently proposable historical seeds into inert candidate playbooks with idempotent resume and clear counts.
items.userSees: Historical seeds can be converted into candidate playbooks without manual 20-item loops.
excludes: No candidate becomes active from backfill alone
No lifecycle gate evidence is created

happy.desc: A fixture with multiple proposable seeds backfills all candidates in one apply run.

edge.desc: A second apply run is idempotent and reports already represented seeds instead of duplicating candidates.

adversarial.desc: Backfill refuses stale observe digest and never activates candidates or writes outcome rows.

verificationEvidence.note: Hermetic smoke backfilled 131 deduped dev-memory seeds in one apply run, including a pre-staged proposal converted to a candidate.
Repeat apply with the current observeDigest created zero duplicate candidates and reported all sources already represented.
Smoke asserted stale observeDigest refusal, all resulting playbooks stayed status=candidate, staged proposal was deleted, and no outcome rows were written.

items.title: Add bounded candidate trial exposure and matched-control observation
items.context: Add a non-authoritative trial surface that can record candidate inspection exposures and matched control observations for evidence gathering without surfacing candidates as active runtime guidance.
items.userSees: Candidate playbooks can collect real exposure/outcome data before activation.
excludes: No trial traffic can satisfy DONE
No matched control can replace explicit outcome evidence

happy.desc: A candidate trial records concrete exposure and matched control rows and promotion status reports them.

edge.desc: Trial is bounded by candidate status, limit, and deterministic match keys.

adversarial.desc: Trial refuses active-only mutation, authority claims, and activation without helped outcome evidence.

verificationEvidence.note: Hermetic smoke recorded one unknown candidate-inspection exposure and one matched-control ledger row for a candidate playbook, then reported them through promotion status.
Smoke asserted candidate-only selection, active playbook exclusion, explicit limit behavior, deterministic idempotency keys, and repeat apply no-op.
Smoke asserted trial outcomes remain non-authoritative unknown candidate-trial evidence with no helped verdict and no activation of candidates.

items.title: Add timer automation entrypoint with fail-closed policy
items.context: Add an explicit timer/sweep command that can run backfill, promotion sweep, and evidence activation according to flags and policy while remaining non-authoritative and bounded.
items.userSees: The playbook lifecycle can be advanced by a repeatable automation command instead of relying on a human remembering each step.

happy.desc: Timer dry-run explains planned work and apply only runs enabled bounded actions.

edge.desc: Disabled actions are reported as skipped, not silently ignored.

adversarial.desc: Timer cannot activate candidates unless existing evidence activation guards pass.

verificationEvidence.note: Hermetic smoke exercised promotion timer dry-run and apply with explicit bounded backfill/trial/activate steps and verified apply only ran enabled bounded actions.
Smoke asserted unrequested timer actions are reported disabled/skipped and requested steps honor explicit limits rather than running hidden background work.
Smoke asserted timer activation delegates to the existing auto-promotion guard and blocks unknown-only candidates instead of activating them.
